title: Deeper/broader native DXF reader loss-accounting and artifact match review
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Inspect the optional MLightCAD native DXF converter at its source/API boundary
Separate its native MIT route from the GPL dxf-json fork and LibreDWG DWG adapter
Determine what unknown/loss accounting is available to a composed DXF comparison
Refresh route identity for browser CAD consumers and refine optional-run readiness

method.kind: Primary-source review of repository source, API documentation, README/FAQ, and package metadata
method.limitations: Project source, API docs, package metadata, and viewer documentation establish implementation structure and advertised route boundaries only. No exact npm tarball/source commit pair was resolved, no parser lineage audit or ASCII/Binary runtime test was performed, and no drawing was parsed. The native database projection is not raw-byte retention evidence.

sources.revision: Mutable main/API docs reviewed 2026-10-18; no exact release tag bound
sources.observed: The documented MIT-native converter constructs AcDbDxfFiler and AcDbDxfDocumentReader, streams directly into AcDbDatabase instead of using the ParsedDxf JSON intermediate, and returns an aggregate unknownEntityCount. This establishes a distinct converter path, not per-record completeness, raw-byte retention, or full ASCII/Binary coverage.

sources.revision: Current API documentation reviewed 2026-10-18; source commit not bound
sources.observed: The object reader documents an aggregate unknownObjectCount for OBJECTS types without a native reader. It does not expose a per-object disposition or raw payload through that counter alone.

sources.revision: npm page snapshot listed 1.15.8; mutable source package manifest reported 1.15.10 on 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The reviewed release and mutable source snapshots do not establish a matching artifact/source pair. This may be unreleased main or metadata lag; exact tarball integrity and source commit must be reconciled before any optional run. The project documents the DWG adapter separately as LibreDWG compiled to WebAssembly.

sources.revision: Current repository README and changelog reviewed 2026-10-18; mutable references
sources.observed: The public dxf-json repository declares itself a GPL-3.0 fork of dotoritos-kim/dxf-json and lists entity/object extensions. It is a separate converter path from AcDbNativeDxfConverter, but this does not establish independent authorship across all shared/project code or provide a complete coverage matrix.

sources.revision: Current README/FAQ snapshots reviewed 2026-10-18; mutable references
sources.observed: MLightCAD separates its native DXF path from opt-in LibreDWG DWG conversion and describes a 2D-focused viewer. Flyfish documents LibreDWG WASM for DWG and JavaScript parsing plus fallback for DXF into a 2D rendering model; its DWF 3D route is separate. These are consumer/projection paths, not additional independent DWG codecs or 3D semantic oracles.

assessment.planImpact: Tightens the existing optional MLightCAD DXF candidate gate: distinguish direct typed database projection from raw preservation, require exact package/source reconciliation and explicit ASCII/Binary scope, independently account unknown wire content, and keep browser/DWG viewer routes deduplicated under their parser lineage. No implementation or validation cadence changed.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep AcDbNativeDxfConverter optional and select it only for a named DXF question not answered by the already-pinned comparator route.
Resolve the npm tarball version/integrity against an immutable source commit and license before running; record ARTIFACT_SOURCE_UNRESOLVED / NOT_RUN if this is not quick to prove.
Confirm ASCII and Binary DXF support from the exact source and tests; do not infer both from the ArrayBuffer converter API.
Compare the typed database to an independently authored local manifest keyed by source handle/type/owner/space and exact values; collect unknownEntityCount and unknownObjectCount as diagnostics only.
Independently inspect the raw DXF group stream to detect untyped, skipped, and unsupported input; a zero unknown count is not a preservation claim.
Classify viewer output as projection only; count DWG routes under LibreDWG lineage and keep DWF 3D separate from DWG/ACIS semantics.
Keep all inputs locally authored or in-memory, add no external fixture/dependency, and leave J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
